en.headline: Harris Ho wins Hong Kong's first Youth Olympics individual fencing gold
en.dek: The 17-year-old foil specialist beat Japan's Masashi Maeda 15-8 in the Dakar final, giving the city its second gold of the Games and its first individual fencing title at the Youth Olympics.
body: Hong Kong fencer Harris Ho Shing-him won gold in the men's foil at the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar, Senegal, on Monday, becoming the first Hong Kong athlete to take an individual fencing title at the Games.

Ho, ranked among the world's top juniors and the only fencer in the 15-strong Hong Kong squad, defeated Japan's Masashi Maeda 15-8 in the final. The International Fencing Federation confirmed the result. Ho had already beaten Maeda by the same score in the cadet world championships semi-final earlier this year.

In the pool stage Ho finished 5-1 to reach the last eight, then beat Czech fencer Krystof Novak 15-2 and Cyprus's Aris Kiayias 15-10 in the semi-final. Hong Kong has previously won Youth Olympic fencing silvers through Ryan Choi and Kaylin She.

Ho told the International Fencing Federation he focused on adjusting tactics quickly whenever one action stopped working. Hong Kong has so far won two golds at the Dakar Games, the other by wushu athlete Poon Ho-yin.

zh.headline: 何承謙摘青奧男子花劍金牌 香港劍擊首個人金
zh.dek: 17歲何承謙在達喀爾決賽以十五比八擊敗日本前田將志，為香港摘下青奧第二金，亦是香港劍擊青奧首個人金牌。
body: 香港劍擊手何承謙週一在塞內加爾達喀爾青年奧運會摘下男子花劍金牌，成為香港首位在青奧摘得劍擊個人金牌的運動員。
國際劍擊聯盟確認，何承謙以十五比八擊敗日本劍手前田將志。他是香港代表團唯一劍擊選手，年初已奪得世界少年組冠軍，並在年初世少賽四強以同樣比分擊敗前田。
小組賽何承謙得五勝一負出線，八強以十五比二大勝捷克劍手，四強再以十五比十擊敗塞浦路斯劍手，晉級決賽。香港過往在青奧劍擊只有蔡俊彥及佘繕妑摘銀。
何承謙事後表示，比賽中一旦動作失效便立即改變戦術。香港代表團在達喀爾青奧目前已摘得兩金，另一金由武術選手潘浩然奪得。
